name: syntax
title: Syntax highlighting
description: Syntax lexing for code: gpu-lexer (a small WebGPU model that labels spans in any language) behind one shared device, queue and cache, with the kit's synchronous lexer (lib/syntax-lexer) as the fallback when WebGPU is missing or software-only. lexSyntax labels a source; tokenizeLines splits the spans into CodeEditor's per-line tokens; languageFromPath picks a language from a file name.
